hooks.command: jq -r '.session_id // ""' | { read -r sid; trash="$HOME/.claude/stale-tasks/$(date +%s)"; for d in "$HOME/.claude/todos" "$HOME/.claude/tasks"; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; if find "$d" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name "*${sid:-no-session}*" -mmin +5 | grep -q .; then mkdir -p "$trash"; find "$d" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name "*${sid:-no-session}*" -mmin +5 -exec mv -t "$trash/" {} +; fi; done; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Moving tasks from previous sessions to ~/.claude/stale-tasks
